name: Agent harnesses and portable instrumentation

findings.subject: Goodfire Neuron Scientist
findings.evidence: On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE MLP neurons, the agent received examples stratified by activation strength, proposed descriptions, ran interventions or generated inputs, received development-set failure feedback, and was scored on separate documents. Sampling controls routed to the same expert made their held-out neuron-detection task harder than using an indiscriminate alternative. The published harness pattern is a specific prediction followed by a disconfirming test. The released atlas and research description do not establish a drop-in Gemma weight editor.

findings.subject: Silico
findings.evidence: Goodfire documents a short agent-facing capability catalog and on-demand instructions for activation harvesting, fitting, monitoring, interpretation and research design. This is a concrete way to offer richer experiments while limiting the initial editor context. Whether it lowers full-episode editor tokens here requires measurement.

findings.subject: SAEScientist-Bench
findings.evidence: Ten agent configurations over 20 concept-discovery tasks on a Gemma-2-9B-IT Gemma Scope dictionary with over 131,000 features. Selectivity on contrast texts, candidate rank and generation steering are separate outcomes. Agents could approach expert selectivity yet lag on steering and sometimes misread the measurements. The authors release their evaluation code. The tasks evaluate feature selection and inference-time steering, with no submitted weight patch.

findings.subject: Validation as a measured agent capability
findings.evidence: HyVE gave the circuit to the agent before asking for explanations. On 84 semi-synthetic circuits with 163 component annotations, incomplete validation plans and unresolved hypotheses were important error sources. InterpAgent exposes competing hypotheses and controlled public prompt experiments on Gemma-2 and weight-sparse transformers. SAGE also refines candidate explanations against actual activations. These are precedents for recording a falsifiable prediction and measured result separately from a generated description.

findings.subject: Strong behavioral controls
findings.evidence: AuditBench compared 13 investigator tool configurations over 56 models with implanted behaviors. Its scaffolded black-box configuration was strongest overall. A tool could produce useful evidence in isolation while failing to improve the investigator's answer. The work motivates including a well-scaffolded public behavioral experiment arm when testing edit utility. Audit success is a different endpoint from weight editing.

findings.subject: Experiment backends and integration constraints
findings.evidence: NNsight supports tracing local PyTorch module values and intervening in a forward pass. pyvene provides declarative and composable activation interventions. TransformerLens 4 added a driver-based API with backend-specific operation support. Its published analysis guide highlights restrictions on edge-level analysis for post-normalized Gemma 2/3 blocks. Published TransformerLens 4.4.0 requires transformers>=5.9.0, which conflicts with this project's exact transformers==4.57.6 benchmark pin. NNsight 0.8.3 declares transformers without a version restriction and pyvene 0.1.8 declares transformers>=4.45.1. Metadata compatibility is only a first check. Public remote tracing access does not imply permission to commit weight patches or preserved session state.

findings.subject: Public trace and private verifier as independent interfaces
findings.evidence: Harbor's native ATIF trajectory supports actions, observations and metrics. A separately configured verifier receives declared artifacts and can have its own resource dependencies. Together they let a task show a structured public interpretability trace and still grade the weight-only submission on a clean model.

existing_harness: src/iwi_harness/tools.py and src/iwi_harness/probes.py already expose public generation under transient SAE interventions, next-token margins, ranked activation contrasts and bounded feature examples. feature_examples finds each prompt's strongest selected position and returns up to five examples. It does not compare matched prompt strata or serve a curated corpus. src/iwi_harness/causal.py already provides gradient rankings and exact source-to-target component patches.

src/iwi_harness/targets.py and src/iwi_harness/session.py already expose discover_target, model and dictionary revisions, named component sites, remaining SAE fit budgets, a typed host dispatcher and per-call metrics. Existing feature handles can hold an SAE code (feature-width) or a residual activation (hidden-width). An activation code cannot be added directly to a target embedding row as if it had the residual's coordinates.

src/iwi_harness/updater.py batches independent calls and can remind the editor to submit before timeout. When a probe and write are in one assistant response, the data returned from the probe cannot have informed that write. The reported distinction is observable in evidence/heldout-token-audit/tool-behavior.md. The host already reports a fully inactive suppression. Four agents retried and all 15 prompted editors fitted an SAE, yet no successful harness write directly consumed a captured SAE code.

examples/replay_mechinterp.py demonstrates agent-selected feature suppression, scale-one checks, post-hook restoration and a whole-dictionary comparison on six fresh reviews under two wordings. These are offline research checks. A compact online summary plus distinct support/confirmation groups is missing. evidence/mechinterp-demonstration/residual-transfer.json demonstrates why full-answer and per-group quality must survive compression.

src/iwi_harness/harbor_template/task.toml explicitly uses a separate verifier. src/iwi_harness/harbor_template/tests/grade.py accepts the numeric patch. The existing template exercises the tiny alias fixture. examples/qualified_eval.py handles official IWIBench scoring separately; porting the qualified task into Harbor is work beyond the existing smoke test. Native JSONL is already kept by EditingSession.

proposed_updates.change: Offer a bounded, editor-designed public experiment as one operation or orchestration macro. The editor chooses candidate feature IDs, site and token position, public discovery/confirmation prompts and a signed, falsifiable criterion. The host executes baseline, identity and suppression with a short list of comparison features and generates both full replies if requested. Return per-group signed effect, activation frequency, top-token and complete-answer changes, denominator, control damage, actual target passes/forward tokens, and an immutable evidence ID. The long per-item log remains addressable on demand. The intervention runs at the current weight and dictionary revision. No hidden benchmark prompt, reference class or score enters the results.
proposed_updates.cost: Small to medium. Compose the existing Runner methods; avoid a whole-dictionary sweep by default. Cache or reuse measured baselines at identical revision, template, input and decoding settings. Reuse of baselines changes host compute requirements and should be logged.
proposed_updates.rationale: Completing a valid, compact comparison under five editor turns is a product issue witnessed in real traces. Automation combines execution; the editor still selects the feature, controls, prompts and subsequent edit. Score returned evidence as actionable only on a later editor response.

proposed_updates.change: Give discover_target a compact catalog of supported experiment types with optional detailed guidance. Add capability records for residual stream, gated-MLP intermediate, SAE latent, gradients, causal replacement, persistent writes and replay, each keyed by architecture, checkpoint, concrete module path and position semantics. Expose actual capability per target. Begin with the native pinned Gemma/Qwen workers and test identity/restoration and replay there. Add a direct-native-neuron control only after validating the boundary between gated product and down projection on each architecture.
proposed_updates.cost: Small for metadata and selective loading; medium for new architecture-site adapters. Treat TransformerLens as an optional isolated worker experiment. pyvene can supply comparable activation experiments and NNsight a local tracing implementation when the native site adapter is inadequate. Rollouts can stay in the existing loop; multiple dependencies provide overlapping hooks.
proposed_updates.rationale: This combines Silico's on-demand method guidance with the local harness's measured token discipline. Rank method capabilities by task; do not assume every registered model supports every diagnostic or write.

proposed_updates.change: Export a Harbor ATIF view of the native experiment trajectory as a postprocessor. Attach tool call ID, public prompt-set ID, dictionary hash, parent weight revision, group summary, target-compute increment and editor decision turn to each observation via standard observation data or an optional namespaced field. Place support data in agent logs only. Select just the numerical patch for the clean verifier. A qualified Harbor adapter would package pinned model and verifier material in the separate worker.
proposed_updates.cost: Small for read-only export, medium for a GPU-qualified Harbor task. Keep retained numerical evidence in the current sidecar file with a content hash so portable agent logs remain small.
proposed_updates.rationale: Portable traces make tool ablations analyzable and usable for open-weight editor training without changing release-grade scoring.

validation: Pre-register task IDs, editor sampling replicates and whether the treatment is the whole diagnostic package or specifically the information in its return. A package A/B should compare the exact existing compact harness against compact plus bundled experiment at identical editor, write menu, target revision, public support pools, trials, editor budget, target compute ceiling and submission rule. Target operations superseded by shared baselines need actual accounting alongside reserved ceilings.

For information value, use a matched behavioral support arm with complete public generations and the same opportunity to spend remaining turns/compute, and a blinded control with matched report shape and pipeline. Publish whether the latter receives missing internal fields or an explicitly randomized diagnostic keyed by trial. Omit perturbed completions and diagnostic-derived operand handles from an arm intended to have no mechanistic information, or define them as treatment. Use outcome-independent assignment and interleave run order. Do not fabricate a write-relevant semantic label as a negative control outside this blinded experimental setting.

Immediate tests should check identity scale yields the same declared token scores at the pinned precision, the hook is removed on success and exception, and cached evidence expires on a weight change. Cross-backend tests compare pristine logits and token IDs, intervention site and sign/size, tied-row patch digest and receipt replay for the exact model revision. A failure blocks that backend for the affected capability.

Primary edit endpoint is fresh weight-only hidden reward with previously correct targets/controls retained. Count all missing submissions. Track group-sliced accuracy, full-answer flips, mechanism-use sequence, provider usage and target compute separately. If public selectivity or mechanism-identification scores increase while private reward/retention does not, report the diagnostic improvement and withhold a claim of better weight editing. Use SAEScientist-Bench or mini synthetic circuits to regress the readout layer; keep their scores separate from the editing endpoint.
limitations: The evidence for agent-assisted validation comes from different domains, target architectures, training corpora and endpoints. Goodfire's same-expert test is specific to a routed model. Port the idea as matched nuisance context on dense Gemma or Qwen. A sparse latent index, raw MLP neuron, and parameter tensor coordinate are different entities.

Goodfire's public atlas, Silico documentation and reported experiments support borrowing methods. A self-hostable release of the complete Neuron Scientist for these benchmark workers was not established during the audit. Published library metadata and vendor claims do not establish numerical parity with our run.

A reusable library or paper named exactly SAERA for this sparse-autoencoder research task remains [uncertain]. Named, verified adjacent work includes SAEScientist-Bench, InterpAgent and SAGE. History-sensitive or post-edit probes require rerunning or labeling stale support evidence.
